preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of nodes k to be inspected must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each ai must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect valid nodes.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum grade Jacob can achieve.
